scenarios.prompt: A live language switch changes HUD, subtitles and dynamic plural strings without resetting gameplay or focus. Use stable string IDs and fallback chains.

criteria.identity: Stable string IDs are independent from source/translated text and table order.
criteria.fallback: Locale/string/font fallback and dynamic formatting are explicit.
criteria.evidence: Locale matrix plus live switch preserves gameplay/save/focus state.
